_doc: Hub map of the module split, read by scripts/ecosystem-units.py. targets: final module ids; module_aliases: current folder id -> target id; retired: folders without unit.json that are being removed; foundation: the shared base module and the names its code is imported under today; transitional_roots: root-level trees still being moved; version_sources: where the version of each module is read from (unit.json must equal it); ownership, path_patterns and path_suffixes are filled by the ownership-map and boundary checks.
